item.title: 18 Aug — The parlay trap on a CLOB
item.description:
Private — Head of Products
Tonight’s window (Aug 16 23:31 → Aug 18 11:31 +04) had no material regulatory or competitor actions across our P0 probes. One minor signal: Polymarket flagged “Markets and Position data — Degraded performance” today; not material for us.
So we spend the slot on a differentiator we can ship: combo books (parlays) on a CLOB.
